title: Mallworld bookshop/gift shop
content: Has anyone ever been to a book shop/ gift shop that looks like this? Granted that I have been to this place in real life, but in my recent mallworld dreams I keep ending up in a place that looks like this. I am always looking for something in the shop but never purchasing anything, and I always feel that there's someone waiting for me to finish from what I'm doing but nothing sinister.
